title: Core Learning Flow System
description: Four reference-dependent images define a child-friendly mobile learning flow across onboarding, lesson start, practice feedback, and reward moments.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes the mobile device frame, mascot grammar, color system, card hierarchy, and UI spacing. Images 02-04 preserve the same product language while shifting the product moment.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-reference-onboarding-stack first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-placement-lesson-screen, 03-practice-feedback-screen, 04-streak-reward-screen. Queue may run those images concurrently after 01-reference-onboarding-stack is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
